example_sentences_in_bangla: হাফটাইমের পর খেলাটা আরও উত্তেজনাপূর্ণ হয়ে উঠল।
মিটিংয়ের হাফটাইমে সবাই চা খেয়ে ফিরল।
example_sentences_in_english: The game got exciting after half-time.
Everyone returned after the half-time break in the meeting.
history: Borrowed from English sports terminology, particularly football, adapted into Bengali for denoting mid-event breaks.
note: This idiom is a direct transliteration and commonly used in contemporary Bengali, especially among younger or urban speakers familiar with sports.
